message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes 3 of 3, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFD) and strips the combining marks before the title goes to `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say vendored code is never edited by hand.

Products have the same problem: `src/shop/product-url.js` calls `slugify` directly, so "Crème brûlée" still becomes `crme-brle` in shop URLs. I left it alone since you asked only about blog posts. It's the same one-line change if you want it.
